text:
Marta: Quick heads-up 10am PT slot opened for NovaGen pilot kickoff. They want to trial embedding search + streaming and asked for retention defaults + an enablement walkthrough.
Diego: I can cover the streaming SDK examples. Need a minimal recipe for their data flow (ingest -> embeddings -> index). Anyone own the embed cost estimate?
Priya: I will. Can you share their expected daily tokens? I only have "light usage" from sales.
Sam: Sales said ~50k tokens/day for initial 2-week trial. Priya: ok I'll calc and give weekly cost + a suggest cache policy.
Marta: They also want a short comms plan for their CISO about data residency. @onboard-bot can you attach the standard data-residency FAQ?
onboard-bot: Attached: /policies/data-residency-faq-v2.pdf
Diego: For the walkthrough, I’ll demo `streaming.chat.subscribe()` and show a small tiebreaker for partial messages. Will prepare a 7-slide deck.
Priya: Cost note: estimated token cost $125/week at 50k/day with embedding caching. Will include sensitivity bounds (+-30%).
Marta: Cool. Also propose a 1-week checkpoint survey (3 Qs) and a deeper 2-week evaluation call to decide renewal path.
Sam: Put the eval call on calendar for Day 14 EOD PT. I'll invite product and eng liaison.
Diego: Adding a quick script in repo to import sample data and build an index. I'll PR to `pilot-scripts`.
Priya: Sending the cost breakdown in CRM and adding a renewal risk tag "pilot-budget-pending".
Marta: Thanks all, owners: Diego (streaming demo + repo PR), Priya (costs + CRM), Sam (calendar + stakeholders), Marta (CISO comms + overall). Will post pre-reads by EOD.
